methods.name: Single-subject global morphometry
methods.purpose: Project global method: BrainSegVol (or positive brainmask support volume, disclosed separately) is distinct from eTIV. Bilateral WhiteSurfArea is summed; MeanThickness is weighted by those hemisphere areas. Optional full-pial area / 3D convex-hull area is computed as a ratio of bilateral sums, not local gyrification. Correct verified rescale k by powers 1/2/3; unknown history leaves physical outputs empty. Whole-brain species-mean ratios require scale and definition compatibility, not regional homology. For macaque inputs, the direct-native species policy replaces all stats-derived estimators.

steps.statement: Project global method: BrainSegVol (or positive brainmask support volume, disclosed separately) is distinct from eTIV. Bilateral WhiteSurfArea is summed; MeanThickness is weighted by those hemisphere areas. Optional full-pial area / 3D convex-hull area is computed as a ratio of bilateral sums, not local gyrification. Correct verified rescale k by powers 1/2/3; unknown history leaves physical outputs empty. Whole-brain species-mean ratios require scale and definition compatibility, not regional homology.

Macaque global input policy: use final native brainmask.mgz positive-voxel support for brain volume, final white triangle areas for total area, final cortex.label thickness means weighted by hemisphere white areas for global thickness, and final pial/3D-hull area sums for folding ratio. Do not use eTIV, aseg-derived volumes or human-named annotations. A restored native result has remaining k=1 (rescale_applied_and_reverted); NIfTI qform/sform conflicts remain disclosed but those files are excluded from this method.
